title: Average over chain out-neighbours
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:	ext{Fin}(n+1)	o br$, and let $i	ext{ in Fin}(n+1)$ satisfy $i<n$. In the digraph on $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$ where $j$ is an out-neighbour of $i$ exactly when $j=0$ or $j=i+1$, the average of $f$ over the out-neighbours of $i$ is $(f(0)+f(i+1))/2$.
